notes.title: Patch 1.4 released
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

We published a new patch. Fixed a few bugs, slightly improved grammar, revamped the licensing.

We also added a small tribute screen after the credits.

Hug your loved ones.

notes.title: Let's Celebrate 10000 Downloads!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

This time around we don't have much to say or exciting news, this is just a big BIG BIIIIG 

[b][h1]THANK YOU[/h1][/b]

for the incredible support you've shown this little free game so far. This has smashed any expectation we ever had. A whole 10000 people interested? Wow.

So yeah. To everyone: the ones that wishlisted, the ones that downloaded (and it's just sitting in your library), the ones that actually finished it: you rock!

This is what motivates us to dtrive further. Our next game, which is already in development, will be something completely else. Not a visual novel, but a bu-

Ah. Not for now. 

We will forever be greatful. Who knows, amybe some day Kureha and Blackwing will return for another adventure. Until then...
 Thanks again.

- BattleProgrammer

notes.title: It's a SUMMER SALE
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

it's been a while, hasn't it? 

We hope you had a wonderful time playing our small Visual Novel. After kinking out a few bugs, the resonance has been tremendous. Thousands of downloads, overwhelmingly positive reviews, so many screenshots... thank you. From the bottom of our hearts, this is so much more than expected.

We were working tirelessly to make this game a great experience for everyone. Since launch, we added a higher contrast mode for better accessability, repaired the achievment system, made sure the game is Steam-Deck ready...

We think we're in a good state.

In case you have missed it, we also just recently overhauled our shop presence with a few images. Not much, but it now looks cleaner.

As you know, the STEAM SUMMER SALE just started! And of course we are part of it! DO check out the Soundtrack and Deluxe edition, both available on Steam and discounted by 50%. Don't miss out on it~
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1810000/Kuroi_Tsubasa/]Find the DLC here![/url]

 
Speaking of soundtrack - it is also available on Spotify for your listening pleasure.
[url=https://share.amuse.io/1qXym_7QOvp_]Here's all the ways to listen to the music![/url]

Aside from that we also released an exclusive instrumental version of the opening song, Stardust, on YouTube. Check it out here: 
[previewyoutube=W7cMgyC98jw;full][/previewyoutube]
As always, all of the music can be used for stream and video production, as long as you credit us. Use it freely~

Lastly, the discounts also extends to our merch. Use special promo code SUMMER to get 10% off on everything.
[url=https://merch.kuroitsubasa.com/]Get the merch here![/url]

And that's a wrap! Enjoy the summer, my friends.
- BattleProgrammer, lead dev


PS: Blackwing Gaming is working on a new project. Veeeeery early pre-production, but do follow our Twitter for more info down the line.
[url=https://twitter.com/BlackwingGamin1]Twitter here~[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

just a quick hotfix that (hopefully) fixes some weird behaviour regarding the True Blackwing achievement. 

At each startup now the unlocked CGs are counted and synched with the achievement. Additionally, the internal logic of counting should be more robust as well.

So if you've been hit by the "0 progress" issue despite having unlocked all images, in theory after the next startup of the game it should properly count. (Fingers crossed).

Sorry for the inconvenience!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

Thank you for over 3000 downloads! Are you all having fun with the game? For us at BWG this is a huge success, and we hope this excitement can be shared with you.

Today we published a small patch.

[list]
[*] added a disclaimer at the start of the game that the Quickmenu can be accessed by hovering the mouse cursor at the top of the screen; and also that it can be shown permanently via the settings menu
[*] added an optional darker textbox that can be activated via the settings menu for higher contrast
[*] added a brand new CG for the Yamamii arc
[*] fixed various typos
[/list]

Did you know that the textbox opacity can be adjusted freely in the settings as well? If you have trouble reading the text on brighter backgrounds, please do check that out.

We wish you all a wonderful day~

- BattleProgrammer, lead dev

notes.title: Kuroi Tsubasa is out NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

It is finally time. 

Kuroi Tsubasa is now finally released! You can download and play the game for free! Tell your friends! Tell your family! Tell your boss! Tell random people on the street!

Watch the release trailer here:
[previewyoutube=gOLJ5H6QCU4;full][/previewyoutube]

If you like the game and want to toss us a bit of appreciation, check out the OST and Deluxe Edition DLC. You get something nice in return!

Additionally, we prepared a shop for merch, which you can find here: https://merch.kuroitsubasa.com/

I want to say so many things, but honestly, currently I am just overwhelmed. My biggest goal is 10 players at the same time… Let’s see if that happens.

I want to thank each and everyone of our team. Without you guys this wouldn’t have been possible!
And I also want to thank everyone who will play this game and enjoy it. Because that’s what it’s all about.

From the bottom of my heart:

Thank you. Enjoy the ride~
-	BattleProgrammer, Lead Dev

notes.title: Kuroi Tsubasa Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello friends!

We are very proud to announce that a release date for Kuroi Tsubasa has finally been set:

[b]April 4th, 10AM GMT.[/b]

It is completely surreal to finally publish this game. Over the last two years so many incredible things have happened. I found new friends online, learned so many new skills, powered through hardships... and the result is finally here.

Each and every one of us worked tirelessly to release the very best thing we could do. And quite honestly, this game has turned out better than any of us could ever imagine.

And we hope that you all can enjoy our creation as well.

To advertise our launch, we have created a website with more infos regarding the story, setting, characters, art and music. If you want to know more, check out our new and fancy site: [url=https://kuroitsubasa.com/]Kuroi Tsubasa.[/url]

Aside from that I want to take a moment and talk about the available bonus content.
There is a DLC, which includes an in-game Character and model viewer. also a screenshot mode, as well as 4k desktop wallpapers, and finally a special, otherwise unreleased song.
The other part is the OST which includes over 60 songs from the game in high quality. If you purchase the OST, you will be allowed to use the songs in your own streams and video production!*

Both pieces of DLC are $4.99 each, or $7.99 for a bundle.

If you like the game, consider supporting us via the DLC so we can make more cool, fancy, bigger games!

Thank you!

See you all in two weeks!


- BattleProgrammer, lead dev






* [i]as long as proper attribution is given[/i]

notes.title: Kuroi Tsubasa will be part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We haven't posted an update in a while. That's because we are trucking on full steam (heh, pun intended) ahead towards our planned release!

[h2]Demo changes[/h2]
First and foremost: we want to thank you all for following this game and trying our demo. Without you all this game wouldn't have been possible. 

After some user feedback there are two minor changes to the demo:
- We fixed a bug that sometimes not all images would show as intended. This was caused by a faulty version of the engine, and is now resolved
- We completely overhauled the Tanaka sprite!

Additionally, there is now a thread on our community boards here on Steam where you can leave your suggestions and complaints about the demo. Please check it out and give your honest feedback!

[h2]Overhauled Steam presence[/h2]
As you might have seen, we completely oberhauled our shop presence on Steam. The new banners and images reflect our game so much better than the old, boring ones. Blackwing smugly staring into your eyes is something everybody needs [strike]and deserves[/strike].

There's also some news regarding our socials: Check out our YouTube channel where we uploaded teasers and reveals over the last couple of weeks! How about this exclusive scene showcase for example: [previewyoutube=YcMyhgYtcTc;full][/previewyoutube]

Aside from that there's also more and better structured songs in the OST! Split into two discs, with some super cool new cover art, over 60 songs just for you all to enjoy.

And lastly, finally some preview screenshots for the deluxe version and character viewer.

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]
Starting on the 21. of February Steam will present the STEAM NEXT FEST, a showcase of upcoming games. And we are obviously part of it! Please take this opportunity to share our game and the demo with friends and family that might be interested to play. Heck, fire up the demo yourself to gaze upon the glory of new new Tanaka.


And that about wraps it up.
Thank you all for reading, and we wish you a wonderful time!

Dreams do come true. Just a few more weeks.

- Blackwing Gaming

notes.title: KUROI TSUBASA DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
[h2]DEMO IS OUT[/h2]

Hello everyone!

First of all: thank you so much for following this dinky little game. We were working on this for a quite a while, so seeing all of this come together makes my heart flutter.

The demo is now RELEASED!

A demo which represents the hard work of 1,5 years.

It shows a small glimpse of what the full game has to offer - the premise and origin story of our heroine, Kureha Kurono, and the dilemma of the protagonist, Blackwing-chan.

Please enjoy the short prologue to the fullest.

Kuroi Tsubasa will hopefully release in April. We are working in MAXIMUM OVERDRIVE to deliver the best we can on time.

In case you didn't know: The game will release FOR FREE! No payment, no microtransaction, just free to enjoy.

Stay tuned for the next news~

- Battleprogrammer, Blackwing Gaming
